'''Elle''' is a [[novice]] among the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]], she is from the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref/book|c|Elle}}

== Appearance ==
She is tall and pretty with braided fair hair and complexion, unusual for a Two Rivers girl.

==Abilities ==
She is described as 'very strong' in the [[One Power]], likely on the same level as [[Lelaine Akashi]], [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]], [[Romanda Cassin]], [[Zarya Alkaese]], and [[Rainyn]], and possibly even stronger.

==History==
She is from [[Watch Hill]] in the Two Rivers.

==Activities==
She was among five girls born with the [[spark]] found in the Two Rivers by [[Verin Mathwin]] and [[Alanna Mosvani]] and judged suitable for training.{{ref/book|6|10}} She accompanied several other [[Two Rivers]] girls, possibly three others from Watch Hill,{{verify}} with channeling abilities to [[Caemlyn]]. She eventually joined the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Murandy]], and becomes a [[novice]].
